name: Discogs-Bot
author: Alexandre
summary: Searches and manages a Discogs collection and wantlist, checks listings, and helps identify physical records.
starterPrompt: Search my Discogs collection and wantlist for this release, then compare available pressings and current listings.
usageNote: This uses a signed-in account. Protect session data and confirm every collection change, cart action, order, and purchase yourself.
